name: dev-panel
description: Panel web local (modo oscuro) para el entorno de desarrollo de e-sueldos

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "yarn workspace @dev-panel/server dev" "yarn workspace @dev-panel/web dev"
scripts.build: yarn workspace @dev-panel/web build && yarn workspace @dev-panel/server build
scripts.verify: yarn typecheck && yarn lint && yarn test && yarn build
